testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, touchables, inputs, and key text nodes MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React Native components (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, Image, ImageBackground, SafeAreaView).
Implement navigation using React Navigation (Stack for auth/splash, Bottom Tabs for User, Drawer or Bottom Tabs for Admin).
Apply the `background_watermark` globally on User screens using ImageBackground with `opacity: 0.05` to `0.1` max to keep it subtle.
For quiz bullets, render the claw icon from the provided logos artifact using an Image component.
On correct answers, swap the claw bullet with the check icon from the logos artifact.
The login screen MUST have the 'gerabdevsoft_logo' pinned to the bottom of the screen (absolute positioning or flex-end).
Ensure the green color (#57cc02) is used strictly for success states, active selections, points highlights, or primary calls to action like 'Responder' or 'Ejecutar Sorteo'.
Maintain high contrast for readability using the dark blue (#002954) for primary text and headings.
All copy and UI text must be in Spanish as per user requirements.
